description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayEndpointID component of the OpenClaw project, verifying its decoding and normalization of service names, handling of non-service endpoints, and decoding of Bonjour escape sequences.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointIDTests
classes.description: A test suite containing multiple test cases for GatewayEndpointID functionalities.

methods.name: stableIDForServiceDecodesAndNormalizesName
methods.description: Tests that the stableID method correctly decodes and normalizes service names with Bonjour escapes.

methods.name: stableIDForNonServiceUsesEndpointDescription
methods.description: Tests that the stableID method returns a descriptive string for non-service endpoints.

methods.name: prettyDescriptionDecodesBonjourEscapes
methods.description: Verifies that the prettyDescription method properly decodes Bonjour escape sequences.
